sections.title: Overview
sections.body: Co-founded Telefonica Alpha Health (later Koa Health) and grew the product and design team from 1 to 40 people. Built a portfolio of digital mental health products that raised €66M in investment and reached 3 million users across 70+ countries.

sections.title: Key work
sections.body:
• Designed, tested and launched a mental health crisis prediction service based on an ML model with the NHS — 80% recall, 28 days in advance
  • Launched a mental health and wellbeing product in collaboration with Harvard Medical School and Massachusetts General Hospital — 55% reduction in symptoms, 95% cost reduction in clinical trial
  • Led clinical trial of a DTx product used alongside Spravato (Janssen/J&J)
  • Launched company-wide innovation program across data science, AI, development and design — 62% increase in velocity, 82% decrease in cost per investigation
  • Created and managed product vision, portfolio and OKRs/KPIs across 70+ countries

sections.title: Key outcomes
sections.body:
• €66M investment raised
  • 3M users in 70+ countries
  • 80% recall on ML-based crisis prediction
  • 62% increase in velocity
  • 82% decrease in cost per investigation
  • 55% reduction in symptoms (Harvard clinical trial)
